# Filter Operator Reference

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED:filter-operators — DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY. Run pnpm generate:docs to regenerate. -->

Primebrick entity list endpoints (`GET /api/v1/entities/:entity/list`) accept a
`filters` array. Each filter condition specifies a `field`, an `op` (operator),
and a `value`. This document lists every supported operator.

| Operator | Description | Value type |
|----------|-------------|------------|
| `=` | Equality. Matches rows where the field equals the value. | string / number |
| `!=` | Inequality. Matches rows where the field does not equal the value. | string / number |
| `<>` | Inequality (ANSI alternative to !=). Same behavior as !=. | string / number |
| `<` | Less than. Matches rows where the field is strictly less than the value. | string / number |
| `<=` | Less than or equal. Matches rows where the field is &#60;= the value. | string / number |
| `>` | Greater than. Matches rows where the field is strictly greater than the value. | string / number |
| `>=` | Greater than or equal. Matches rows where the field is &#62;= the value. | string / number |
| `ILIKE` | Case-insensitive pattern match (PostgreSQL). Use % as wildcard for any sequence, _ for any single char. | string / number |
| `LIKE` | Case-sensitive pattern match. Use % and _ wildcards. | string / number |
| `IN` | Membership in a set. Value is an array; matches rows where the field equals any element. | array |
| `NOT IN` | Exclusion from a set. Value is an array; matches rows where the field is not any element. | array |
| `BETWEEN` | Range check. Value is an object &#123; start, end &#125;; matches rows where start &#60;= field &#60;= end. | `{ start, end }` |
| `IS` | Null/boolean check. Use value: null for IS NULL, true/false for boolean. | null / boolean |
| `IS NOT` | Negated null/boolean check. Use value: null for IS NOT NULL. | null / boolean |
| `<=>` | Custom operator. | string / number |
| `<->` | Custom operator. | string / number |
| `<#>` | Custom operator. | string / number |
| `<+>` | Custom operator. | string / number |
| `<~>` | Custom operator. | string / number |
| `<%>` | Custom operator. | string / number |
| `@@` | Custom operator. | string / number |

## Filter connectors

When multiple filters are provided, they are combined with a connector:
- `AND` (default) — all filters must match
- `OR` — any filter must match
